flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Click Add bill and enter the name Rent.
Enter the amount 1,000.00 and choose all three people, Ana, Ben and Cy, with an equal split.
Save the bill and look at each person's share of the bill.
Assert Ana's share shows 333.34.
Assert Ben's share shows 333.33.
Assert Cy's share shows 333.33.
Store The shares shown for Ana, Ben and Cy, in that order, as one comma-separated line as 'equal_split_shares'.
